precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders. Hann/windowed FFT use deterministic double-single (two binary32 components), then RN32 complex output; see docs/SPACE_ZERO_BIT_AMENDMENTS.md for the exact operation graph. No native GPU float64 required.
validation_method: Full raw GPU bytes against independent CPU binary32 reference; CPU operations cross-checked with exact Fraction oracle; historical double/scientific invariants reported separately, never substituted for zero-bit gate.
